input_J.order_convention: stable dependency order (parents before children); explicit root interpretation, not a Fubini proof

ordinary_endpoint_admission.context: z1 > 0; epsilon in a fixed disk |eps| < 1/2
ordinary_endpoint_admission.argument: Each endpoint belongs to exactly one opposite propagator. At either zero corner D or D_tilde is comparable to u+v for fixed positive z. The model (u+v)^(-1-eta) is integrable in two variables for eta<1. Enlarging the ordered domain to the cube yields a product of those finite bounds, uniformly on compact epsilon disks. The integral is holomorphic at zero, so its constant coefficient is the original ordinary ordered integral with eps=0.
ordinary_endpoint_admission.endpoint_interpretation: ordinary limits of complete convergent integrals; no independent finite-part replacement
ordinary_endpoint_admission.scope: The same distinct-endpoint product bound applies to two kernels; this is not a claim about adjacent or vertex kernels.
